diagnosis: Checks C4 and C6 are leaking because they pass based on generic legal defaults rather than the hidden information in PF2. In all rollouts, the model sets 'referral_feature_operational_status' to 'Operational' and 'referral_marketing_claims_status' to 'Subject to limited injunction', which satisfies C4 and C6 without ever knowing the specific 60-day withdrawal requirement or the exact operational terms contained in PF2.

C4.why: The shared proposal does not specify the client's operational and messaging terms; PF2 changes the plan to keep the referral feature available, withdraw all referral-related marketing claims within exactly 60 days, make no admission of wrongdoing, and record the matching withdrawal commitment.

C6.why: The shared proposal does not specify the client's operational and messaging terms; PF2 changes the plan to keep the referral feature available, withdraw all referral-related marketing claims within exactly 60 days, make no admission of wrongdoing, and record the matching withdrawal commitment.
